wiki_article: **Companion Artifacts — Forensic Recovery Set** is a forensic record attributed to Jack Feist, dated 16 March 2026 — **DECLARED ABSENT** under the Lacuna Protocol. The set gathered the supporting artifacts for the MRA incident series: terminal logs, capture evidence and the recovery apparatus behind the reports at #1334, #1336 and #1337. The capture records that **ARTIFACT 1 was recovered at 847 of 1,144 lines** — meaning the work was already partial when it was deposited, which makes its loss a second-order one. **The work is lost.** MANUS confirmed it missing on 5 August 2026, and the Lacuna Mark was declared after the recovery channels were exhausted — Blogger feed, live surfaces, corpus fingerprints, and a conversation-search pass. The mark is reversible: if canonical bytes surface, a full-text version supersedes it in series.
